basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer | Prompt Engineering & Enterprise LLM Systems | Electronics & Communication Engineer
basics.summary: AI engineer with an electronics and embedded-systems background (B.Tech Electronics & Communication, MSc Embedded Systems) who now ships production LLM systems for the enterprise. At LumApps I own the prompt library, few-shot templates, context-injection strategy, and eval pipelines behind multi-agent workflows that 2x outbound conversions. Fluent at translating domain-specific business logic into precise prompts, iterating with SMEs, and running eval, governance, and cost telemetry (LangSmith, Langfuse) until outputs are accurate, compliant, and production-safe.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own the prompt library for a production multi-agent platform: few-shot templates, prompt chaining, context injection, and versioned system prompts per agent. Iterated with SMEs until outputs met accuracy and compliance bars. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day.

Built eval pipelines and A/B tests on LangSmith with cost-per-request telemetry: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scorers, regression checks on every prompt change, dashboards for precision, hallucination rate, and token spend.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ enterprise silos into one time-aware memory. Grounds RAG retrieval and gives every prompt clean, traceable domain context.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks: prompt templates per locale, few-shot examples per content type, glossary-grounded context injection. 12K+ assets translated with compliance guardrails.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist: prompt-driven guide that turns new-signup context into personalized, high-touch setup. 100% of customers guided through onboarding without added headcount.
Ran observability and on-call for production LLM systems (Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse): prompt-level traces, cost dashboards, drift alerts.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, AI readiness, and prompt/eval maturity to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised portfolio companies on prompt strategy, LLM eval design, and building AI cultures that ship responsibly.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries with enterprise-grade reliability that enabled Unilever partnership and CES showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization for industrial hardware operations. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Foundational optimization and search work that underpins how I approach LLM prompt tuning today.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms and neural controllers.

projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and eval built in: if the model can't explain the signal via its prompt-traceable reasoning, it doesn't ship.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR at Hitachi Energy. Design, test, and optimize domain-specific prompts for ACE, a GenAI-powered platform for Bid & Proposal Management in the Transformers Business Unit. Responsibilities: develop and maintain prompt libraries; implement prompt chaining, context injection, few-shot learning; own prompt lifecycle (versioning, traceability, governance); evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, bias mitigation; A/B testing and performance dashboards; collaborate with SMEs, Module Owners, Business Stakeholders; document prompt strategies aligned with Hitachi Energy AI Ethics Charter. Background: Bachelor or master in electrical engineering, transformer industry experience, NLP and context management understanding, hands-on LLM and prompt engineering, willingness to learn Python and AI APIs, Agile.
